Sir I have one doubt.  It is related to gold.  Suppose a person is accumulating gold coin and he is paying gst on that 3 percent.  Then one day wen he goes to sell why doesn't the dealer or the person buy with gst.  Why at that point they ignore gst.  That means the customer is at loss for paying gst right. The shopkeeper may get refund of that gst but what about the customer wen he takes and goes and sell it back to the shopkeeper wen the price rise.  U may argue that the customer is getting profit while selling. But the shopkeeper also sold with profit only right.  

So in such cases is gold coin benificable to accumulate or ornaments sir.  I have a doubt . Which is more profitable.
